endpoint: exact normalized IC50 represented as pChEMBL
prediction_estimand: Comparable measurement for a previously measured compound in a publication whose outcomes are not available at prediction time
aggregation: Median within compound-publication after upstream compatibility filtering

model.equation: Y_cs = median(Y_c, other allowed studies) + alpha + u_s + StudentT(4, 0, sigma)
model.unseen_study: Integrate u_new over its population distribution

validation.study_grouped: Leave one publication out; retrospective and not time restricted
validation.forward_temporal: Train only on publication years strictly earlier than the held-out year
validation.same_compound_prior_measurements: Allowed by the declared transfer estimand
